# industry_ret: 中信行业指数周收益率（行=日期，列=行业名）
# market_ret: 沪深300周收益率
# 对每个行业滚动24周OLS，计算标准化残差均值
# 最终：成长相关行业（科技/医药/消费）标准化残差均值 - 价值相关行业（金融/能源/地产）标准化残差均值
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
def rolling_ols_resid_norm(ind_ret, mkt_ret, window=24, n=4):
    results = []
    for i in range(window, len(ind_ret)+1):
        y = ind_ret.iloc[i-window:i]
        x = mkt_ret.iloc[i-window:i].values.reshape(-1,1)
        reg = LinearRegression().fit(x, y)
        resid = y - reg.predict(x)
        std_resid = resid / resid.std()
        results.append(std_resid.iloc[-n:].mean())
    return pd.Series(results, index=ind_ret.index[window-1:])
# 对成长行业和价值行业分别计算，取差值
growth_industries = ['中信行业指数:计算机','中信行业指数:电子','中信行业指数:医药','中信行业指数:电力设备及新能源','中信行业指数:传媒']
value_industries  = ['中信行业指数:银行','中信行业指数:非银行金融','中信行业指数:石油石化','中信行业指数:煤炭','中信行业指数:房地产']
growth_score = rolling_ols_resid_norm(industry_ret[growth_industries], market_ret).mean(axis=1)
value_score  = rolling_ols_resid_norm(industry_ret[value_industries], market_ret).mean(axis=1)
raw = growth_score - value_score
factor = calc_rolling_zscore(raw, window=504)

def rolling_slope(series, window=12):
    slopes = series.copy() * np.nan
    for i in range(window - 1, len(series)):
        y = series.iloc[i - window + 1: i + 1].values
        x = np.arange(window)
        slopes.iloc[i] = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0]
    return slopes

slope_g = rolling_slope(close_g, 12)
slope_v = rolling_slope(close_v, 12)
diff_g = slope_g - slope_g.shift(1)
diff_v = slope_v - slope_v.shift(1)
raw = diff_g - diff_v
factor = calc_rolling_zscore(raw, window=504)

# 构建高低PB分组：每月末按PB分位数分成高PB（前30%）和低PB（后30%）组合
# pb_panel: 宽表，行=TRADE_DT，列=个股，值=PB
# price_panel: 宽表，行=TRADE_DT，列=个股，值=收盘价（复权）
pb_rank = pb_panel.rank(axis=1, pct=True)  # 截面分位数
low_pb_mask  = pb_rank <= 0.3
high_pb_mask = pb_rank >= 0.7
stock_ret = price_panel.pct_change()  # 个股日收益率
low_pb_ret  = stock_ret[low_pb_mask].mean(axis=1)   # 低PB等权组合收益
high_pb_ret = stock_ret[high_pb_mask].mean(axis=1)  # 高PB等权组合收益
raw = low_pb_ret - high_pb_ret  # 低PB超额收益
# 原始系数-0.01，即低PB-高PB >0 对应value占优，方向与规范相反，乘以-1
factor = calc_rolling_zscore(raw, window=504) * (-1)
